china_race_dynamics.text: The Chinese Communist Party is trying to turn America’s AI breakthroughs into Beijing’s strategic advantage. Through adversarial model distillation and the rapid global distribution of PRC-developed models, China is working to undercut U.S. leadership, weaken trusted American alternatives, and embed CCP-aligned technology across the software supply chains our economy and national security depend on.

deepseek.reason: The speaker describes China's efforts to undercut US AI leadership but does not explicitly call for making competition a policy priority.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement is critical of China but lacks an explicit endorsement of race priority.
